reuse.why: Introduces and reuses getMonthWideCategories for setZero, the N-month averages and the new action, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own getBudgetData path and the #fixed check uses a private regex instead of shared/tags.ts.

duplication.why: The exclusion rule is spread over getMonthWideCategories and getBudgetData (template SQL fragment and fixed-group filter applied twice) plus copyPreviousMonth's own hidden/includeHidden branch, and setLastMonthSpending copies the income gate and sign flip from set3MonthAvg.

placement.why: Selection logic lives in budget/actions.ts beside the actions and the new method is registered in app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps; release notes and tests per step, nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: A shared selector exists but 'which categories a month-wide action writes' is still decided in three shapes (SQL string fragments, JS group filter, and an inline check in copyPreviousMonth), so the next exclusion must be added in several places again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts copyPreviousMonth uses getBudgetData plus its own `!includeHiddenCategories && (hidden || group_hidden)` check instead of getMonthWideCategories; FIXED_TAG regex bypasses shared/tags.ts parsing.

disguised_duplication.where: The month-wide exclusion rule is split into NO_SAVED_TEMPLATES SQL, getFixedGroupIds filtering repeated in getBudgetData and getMonthWideCategories, and a JS hidden branch in copyPreviousMonth, rather than one predicate.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gains includeHiddenCategories with a conditional SQL fragment; copyPreviousMonth bypasses it via getBudgetData with its own hidden/income checks.
